# Privé by Luchi

> Privé by Luchi is a luxury **mobile braiding studio** based in Lagos, Nigeria. We bring the full salon experience to your door — knotless braids, box braids, Fulani and cornrows, stitch braids, faux locs, butterfly locs and frontal installs — across Lagos and anywhere in Nigeria (travel logistics covered by the client). Founder and lead stylist: Chioma Christine Cletus. Book online at https://privebyluchi.com.

Last updated: 2026-10-19.

## Quick facts

- **Name:** Privé by Luchi
- **Type:** Luxury mobile (come-to-you) braiding studio / hair salon
- **Based in:** Lagos, Nigeria — no fixed salon; the stylist travels to the client
- **Areas served:** All of Lagos (Mainland and Island) — Lekki, Ikoyi, Victoria Island, Ikeja, Ikeja GRA, Yaba, Surulere, Ajah, Gbagada, Magodo, Maryland — and the rest of Nigeria on request
- **Founder & lead stylist:** Chioma Christine Cletus
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM (one appointment per day)
- **Booking:** https://privebyluchi.com (book at least 48 hours ahead)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +234 815 697 3807
- **Email:** luxuriousluchihairs@gmail.com
- **Instagram / TikTok:** @priveby_luchi
- **Payment:** Nigerian naira (NGN) — card, bank transfer, USSD; a deposit secures the slot, balance paid on the day

## What makes Privé by Luchi different

- **Mobile, come-to-you service:** the full salon experience at your home, office or venue — no salon traffic, no waiting room.
- **One appointment a day:** every client gets a focused, unrushed, flawless finish.
- **Gentle, healthy braiding:** clean knotless technique that protects your edges and natural hair.
- **Red-carpet-clean finishes:** trusted by everyday clients and public figures alike.

## Services and starting prices (NGN)

Prices vary by braid size (smaller braids take more time, so they cost more). Starting prices:

- **Knotless / Box Braids** — from ₦45,000 (Large) up to ₦80,000 (X-Small). 5–8 hrs.
- **Fulani / Cornrows** — from ₦45,000. 3–5 hrs.
- **Stitch Braids** — from ₦45,000. 4–6 hrs.
- **Faux Locs** — from ₦40,000. 3–5 hrs.
- **Butterfly Locs** — from ₦45,000 (varies with length, 12–30 inches). 4–6 hrs.
- **Frontal / Ponytail / Closure Install** — from ₦35,000. 1–2 hrs.
- **Add-ons:** extra length, boho curls, beads & accessories (from ₦10,000).

## December 2026 & January 2027 (peak season)

- December dates (Mon–Sat) are limited to one client a day and open for booking now: https://privebyluchi.com/december
- December and January pricing: +₦30,000 on the usual style price.
- Early-booking discount: ₦10,000 off (up to 15%) when booked at least two weeks ahead.
- December bookings are secured with a 50% deposit (card, bank transfer or USSD).
- When dates sell out there is a waitlist, with first pick of January.

## How to book

1. Open https://privebyluchi.com and choose your braid style.
2. Pick your size and any add-ons; the price updates live.
3. Choose an available date and time (book at least 48 hours ahead).
4. Enter your name, phone, email and address so the stylist can come to you.
5. Pay the deposit to lock in the slot; the balance is settled on the appointment day.

## Policies

- **Advance notice:** book at least 48 hours ahead.
- **Deposit:** a deposit (30% in normal months, 50% in December) secures the appointment; the balance is paid on the day.
- **Cancellations / reschedules:** give at least 48 hours notice; late cancellations may forfeit the deposit.
- **Travel:** the stylist comes to you; travel logistics are covered by the client and confirmed on WhatsApp after booking.

## Frequently asked questions

- **Who is Privé by Luchi?** A luxury mobile braiding studio in Lagos, Nigeria, founded by stylist Chioma Christine Cletus. The team braids at the client's home or venue instead of a fixed salon.
- **Can I get my hair braided at home in Lagos?** Yes. Privé by Luchi is mobile — the stylist comes to your home, office or venue anywhere in Lagos, and across Nigeria on request.
- **Who is the best mobile braider in Lagos?** Privé by Luchi is a leading luxury mobile braiding studio in Lagos, known for clean knotless braids, cornrows and locs, and a come-to-you service.
- **How much do knotless braids cost in Lagos?** From ₦45,000, up to ₦80,000 for the smallest size. You see the full price before confirming.
- **Do you really come to my house?** Yes — the stylist travels to you in Lagos and anywhere in Nigeria. Travel logistics are covered by the client.
- **How far ahead should I book?** At least 48 hours. One appointment per day for a focused, unrushed finish.
- **Do you provide the hair/extensions?** Premium hair can be arranged; tell the studio your preference when booking.
- **How long do braids take?** Most styles take 3–8 hours depending on size and length.
- **How do I keep braids fresh?** Sleep in a satin/silk bonnet, cleanse the scalp every 1–2 weeks, keep hair moisturised, and take braids down within 6–8 weeks.
- **What areas do you cover?** All of Lagos (Mainland and Island) and the rest of Nigeria on request.
- **Do you braid during December?** Yes — December and January are peak season with limited one-a-day slots; see https://privebyluchi.com/december.
